revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, app-facing raster asset
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the third steps tier. It should feel richer and more ceremonial than tier two, while preserving high contrast and small UI readability.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, delicate pencil outline, gentle cream paper texture, watercolor washes. Center elements: a looped walking route ribbon, several bold dark sage paw-like footprints, small milestone stones, leaves, and a tiny compass-like route marker without any text. No animals and no people.
Style/medium: soft watercolor travel scrapbook, hand-painted, low-saturation TripPet palette, delicate pencil linework, cozy polished mobile game collectible.
Composition/framing: centered single medal, full object visible, generous padding around medal, square composition, readable at small 62pt UI size. Footprints and route marker should be clear and darker than the pale medal base.
Color palette: warm cream paper base, dark muted sage footprints, dusty blue route ribbon, ochre milestone stones, pale peach accent; avoid pure #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese text, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection. Do not create multiple medals; exactly one medal only. Keep subject fully separated from the flat green background with crisp edges.
